---
title: "Generative Periodisation"
---

Generative Periodisation is an ongoing research programme exploring a foundational way to building training plans. It combines Bayesian statistical modelling with ecological dynamics to ask how periodisation plans can be built from constraints, targets, and continuous feedback—adapting to the individual athlete without losing structural coherence.
